description: NaCaAs is half-Heusler structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to four equivalent As³⁻ atoms to form NaAs₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CaAs₄ tetrahedra, corners with twelve equivalent NaAs₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent CaAs₄ tetrahedra. All Na-As bond lengths are 3.00 Å. Ca²⁺ is bonded to four equivalent As³⁻ atoms to form CaAs₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaAs₄ tetrahedra, corners with twelve equivalent CaAs₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent NaAs₄ tetrahedra. All Ca-As bond lengths are 3.00 Å. As³⁻ is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to four equivalent Na¹⁺ and four equivalent Ca²⁺ atoms.
